text:
maria.k: quick heads-up — we're starting a small migration to add an 'env' and 'gpu_type' field to the structured logs before the next canary. will coordinate sampling and redaction rules here
kevin: ok, what's the plan for PII fields? we still see free-text user prompts in some payloads 
lia: plan: add schema validation in logproc to reject any top-level 'user_prompt' unless it's been pseudonymized or moved to pii_payload (which is encrypted). default sampling for those entries will be 1% during canary.
sasha: +1. also recommend adding a boolean 'kv_cache_hit' to help correlate perf with serving runtime — valuable for GPU-burst debugging
maria.k: exactly. schema v2 will include: env, gpu_type, kv_cache_hit, request_size_bytes. we'll deploy validation and a non-blocking warning first so old producers don't fail.
ops-bot: alert: logproc-canary: validation_warnings > 10 in 5m for cluster gpu-prod-us-east-1
jordan: seeing that alert now. what's the threshold for escalation?
kevin: for canary we keep it low: warnings -> slack, errors -> pager. errors shouldn't happen because we start with non-blocking mode.
sasha: on sampling — we should keep full fidelity for any error-level events and for requests hitting >1s tail latency. everything else: 0.5% global sampling, 5% for gpu-prod regions during canary.
maria.k: agreed. can we add a Grafana panel under observability/fleet that shows sampled vs full count and estimated token-volume cost? I want to monitor cost uplift from extra fields.
lia: working on a dashboard draft: panels for 'logs_ingested_total', 'sampled_ratio', 'pii_masked_total', and a 'parquet_bytes_by_env'. will link soon.
kevin: reminder: Prometheus alert rule 'gpu_fleet_log_pressure' needs tuning — previous spike was due to large JSON bodies (request examples). maybe cap message size before enqueueing to kafka?
sasha: we can truncate request examples to 512 bytes and store rest in a secure blob store with reference id. avoids PII in logs and stabilizes throughput.
jordan: who owns the rollout? i can handle canary infra and kafka retention settings.
maria.k: assign to jordan for rollout, lia for dashboard, sasha for schema PR, kevin for prometheus alert tweak. i'll open the RFC and include sample logs + migration hook. <https://redwood.internal/docs/rfcs/log-schema-v2> :thumbsup:
kevin: I'll also add a recording rule to estimate ingest cost: sum by(env)(increase(logproc_ingested_bytes[1h])) / 3600 to approximate bytes/sec and convert to cost in USD via lookup table
sasha: quick snippet for validation rule (logproc):
```json
{
  "required": ["timestamp","trace_id","env"],
  "properties": {
    "env": {"type":"string","enum":["prod","staging","dev"]},
    "gpu_type": {"type":"string"},
    "user_prompt": {"type":"string"}
  }
}
```
maria.k: perfect. make user_prompt optional in schema but ensure the pipeline moves it to pii_payload when present, then replace with "<redacted>" in the emitted event.
ops-bot: deploy:logproc v2-canary started on cluster gpu-canary-eu-west-1 by jordan at 1987654340
jordan: canary is live. i'm watching warnings in the first 10m. lia, link the new grafana panels and i'll keep retention high for 24h.
lia: panels posted: <https://grafana.redwood/internal/d/abc123/log-schema-v2-canary> — added annotations for deploy start and sampling rate changes
kevin: seeing expected drop in throughput (bytes/sec) after truncation patch. no pager so far.
sasha: leaving one TODO: add unit test to ensure serialization keeps kv_cache_hit as boolean and doesn't push it into analytics_index. I'll PR in 30m.
maria.k: thanks team. after 24h canary, we'll ramp sampling down to normal and merge schema v2. i'll run a postmortem checklist for any missed PII exposures.
kevin: one more ask — add a label 'region' to the logs for routing costs by region. helps with committed capacity conversations.
maria.k: noted. will include in RFC.
lia: tagging @eng-platform for visibility. :wave:
